       p.product_name,
       s.first_name AS staff_first_name,
       s.last_name AS staff_last_name

JOIN Customers c ON co.customer_id = c.customer_id

SELECT p.product_name,
       (COUNT(c.complaint_id) + 0.5 * COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.complaint_status_code = 'Open' THEN 1 END), 0)) AS csdi
FROM Products p
LEFT JOIN Complaints c ON p.product_id = c.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY csdi DESC
LIMIT 10;

        c.product_id,

FROM complaint_stats cs
ORDER BY comprehensive_service_defect_index DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH staff_agg AS (
    SELECT
        s.staff_id,
        COUNT(c.complaint_id) AS case_volume,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.complaint_outcome_code = 'OK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(c.complaint_id) AS success_ratio,
        AVG(julianday(c.date_complaint_closed) - julianday(c.date_complaint_raised)) AS avg_latency
    FROM Staff s
    LEFT JOIN Complaints c ON c.staff_id = s.staff_id
    GROUP BY s.staff_id
),
staff_score AS (
    SELECT
        staff_id,
        case_volume,
        success_ratio,
        avg_latency,
        /* proprietary efficiency score = (success_ratio * case_volume) / avg_latency */
        (success_ratio * case_volume) / NULLIF(avg_latency, 0) AS efficiency_score
    FROM staff_agg
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        staff_id,
        efficiency_score,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY efficiency_score DESC) AS rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_staff
    FROM staff_score
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        staff_id,
        efficiency_score,
        ((rn - 1) * 5) / total_staff + 1 AS quintile,
        CASE ((rn - 1) * 5) / total_staff + 1
            WHEN 1 THEN 'A'
            WHEN 2 THEN 'B'
            WHEN 3 THEN 'C'
            WHEN 4 THEN 'D'
            ELSE 'E'
        END AS grade
    FROM ranked
)
SELECT
    staff_id,
    efficiency_score,
    quintile,
    grade
FROM final
ORDER BY efficiency_score DESC;

WITH StaffMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        s.staff_id,
        COUNT(c.complaint_id) AS case_volume,
        COALESCE(AVG(ABS(julianday(c.date_complaint_closed) - julianday(c.date_complaint_raised))), 0) AS avg_resolution_latency,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.complaint_outcome_code = 'OK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS success_ratio
    FROM Staff s
    LEFT JOIN Complaints c ON s.staff_id = c.staff_id
    GROUP BY s.staff_id
),
EfficiencyScores AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.staff_id,
        ((sm.success_ratio * 100) + (sm.case_volume * 10) + (100 / NULLIF(sm.avg_resolution_latency + 1, 0))) AS efficiency_score
    FROM StaffMetrics sm
),
QuintiledStaff AS (
    SELECT 
        es.staff_id,
        es.efficiency_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY es.efficiency_score DESC) AS quintile_rank,
        CASE 
            WHEN es.efficiency_score >= 80 THEN 'A'
            WHEN es.efficiency_score >= 60 THEN 'B'
            WHEN es.efficiency_score >= 40 THEN 'C'
            WHEN es.efficiency_score >= 20 THEN 'D'
            ELSE 'E'
        END AS performance_grade

    qs.performance_grade
FROM QuintiledStaff qs
ORDER BY qs.quintile_rank;

WITH staff_stats AS (
    SELECT
        s.staff_id,
        s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name AS staff_name,
        COUNT(c.complaint_id) AS complaint_volume,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(c.complaint_id) = 0 THEN 0
             ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN c.complaint_outcome_code = 'OK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(c.complaint_id)
        END AS success_ratio,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(c.complaint_id) = 0 THEN 0
             ELSE AVG(julianday(c.date_complaint_closed) - julianday(c.date_complaint_raised))
        END AS avg_latency_days
    FROM Staff s
    LEFT JOIN Complaints c ON s.staff_id = c.staff_id
    GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
),
score_calc AS (
    SELECT
        staff_id,
        staff_name,
        complaint_volume,
        success_ratio,
        avg_latency_days,
        (success_ratio * 100) - avg_latency_days + (LOG(complaint_volume + 1) * 10) AS efficiency_score
    FROM staff_stats
),
quintile_rank AS (
    SELECT
        staff_name,
        efficiency_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY efficiency_score DESC) AS quintile
    FROM score_calc
)
SELECT
    staff_name,
    CASE quintile
        WHEN 1 THEN 'A'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'B'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'C'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'D'
        ELSE 'E'
    END AS letter_grade
FROM quintile_rank
ORDER BY letter_grade, staff_name;

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date_complaint_closed) AS month,
       AVG(CASE complaint_outcome_code
               WHEN 'OK' THEN 5
               WHEN 'Partially Resolved' THEN 3
               WHEN 'Not Resolved' THEN 1
               ELSE NULL
           END) AS average_rating
FROM Complaints
WHERE complaint_status_code = 'Closed'
  AND date_complaint_closed >= DATE('now', '-1 year')
  AND date_complaint_closed <= DATE('now')
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

    CASE complaint_outcome_code
        WHEN 'OK' THEN 5

        WHEN 'Not Resolved' THEN 1
    END

        (SELECT MAX(date_complaint_closed) FROM Complaints),

votes.sql:
WITH complaint_stats AS (
    SELECT p.product_category_code,
           AVG(julianday(c.date_complaint_closed) - julianday(c.date_complaint_raised)) AS avg_resolution_days
    FROM Complaints c
    JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE c.date_complaint_closed IS NOT NULL AND c.date_complaint_raised IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.product_category_code
),
revenue AS (
    SELECT product_category_code,
           SUM(product_price) * 0.93 AS total_revenue_eur
    FROM Products
    GROUP BY product_category_code
)
SELECT r.product_category_code AS category,
       r.total_revenue_eur
FROM revenue r
JOIN complaint_stats cs ON r.product_category_code = cs.product_category_code
WHERE cs.avg_resolution_days < 3;

votes.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE bd AS (
    SELECT complaint_id,
           date(date_complaint_raised) AS d,
           date(date_complaint_closed) AS end_d
    FROM Complaints
    WHERE date_complaint_closed IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT complaint_id,
           date(d, '+1 day'),
           end_d
    FROM bd
    WHERE d < end_d
),
bd_counts AS (
    SELECT complaint_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%w', d) NOT IN ('0','6') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS business_days
    FROM bd
    GROUP BY complaint_id
),
staff_stats AS (
    SELECT s.staff_id,
           s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name AS staff_name,
           AVG(bc.business_days * 1.0) AS avg_business_days,
           SUM(p.product_price) * 0.85 AS total_euros
    FROM Staff s
    JOIN Complaints c ON c.staff_id = s.staff_id
    JOIN bd_counts bc ON bc.complaint_id = c.complaint_id
    JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = c.product_id
    GROUP BY s.staff_id
)
SELECT staff_name,
       avg_business_days,
       total_euros
FROM staff_stats
ORDER BY staff_name;

SELECT 
    s.first_name,
    s.last_name,
    AVG(julianday(c.date_complaint_closed) - julianday(c.date_complaint_raised)) AS avg_close_days,
    SUM(p.product_price * 0.85) AS total_euros
FROM Staff s
JOIN Complaints c ON s.staff_id = c.staff_id
JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.date_complaint_closed IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name

SELECT s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name AS staff_name,
       AVG(julianday(c.date_complaint_closed) - julianday(c.date_complaint_raised)) AS avg_close_days,
       SUM(p.product_price) AS total_euros
FROM Complaints c
JOIN Staff s ON c.staff_id = s.staff_id
JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.date_complaint_raised IS NOT NULL AND c.date_complaint_closed IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name;

votes.sql:
WITH staff_avg AS (
    SELECT s.staff_id,
           s.first_name,
           s.last_name,
           AVG(julianday(c.date_complaint_closed) - julianday(c.date_complaint_raised)) AS avg_resolution_days
    FROM Staff s
    JOIN Complaints c ON s.staff_id = c.staff_id
    WHERE c.complaint_type_code = 'Product Failure'
      AND c.complaint_status_code = 'Closed'
      AND c.date_complaint_closed IS NOT NULL
      AND c.date_complaint_raised IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY s.staff_id
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(julianday(c.date_complaint_closed) - julianday(c.date_complaint_raised)) AS overall_avg_days
    FROM Complaints c
    WHERE c.complaint_type_code = 'Product Failure'
      AND c.complaint_status_code = 'Closed'
      AND c.date_complaint_closed IS NOT NULL
      AND c.date_complaint_raised IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT sa.first_name,
       sa.last_name
FROM staff_avg sa, overall_avg o
WHERE sa.avg_resolution_days < o.overall_avg_days;

votes.sql:
WITH pf AS (
    SELECT staff_id,
           (julianday(date_complaint_closed) - julianday(date_complaint_raised)) AS resolution_days
    FROM Complaints
    WHERE complaint_type_code = 'Product Failure'
),
staff_avg AS (
    SELECT staff_id, AVG(resolution_days) AS avg_resolution
    FROM pf
    GROUP BY staff_id
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(resolution_days) AS overall_avg
    FROM pf
)
SELECT staff_id
FROM staff_avg, overall
WHERE staff_avg.avg_resolution < overall.overall_avg;

WITH RECURSIVE
    date_range AS (
        SELECT complaint_id,
               DATE(date_complaint_raised) AS d,
               DATE(date_complaint_closed) AS end_date
        FROM Complaints
        UNION ALL
        SELECT complaint_id,
               DATE(d, '+1 day'),
               end_date
        FROM date_range
        WHERE d < end_date
    ),
    biz_days AS (
        SELECT dr.complaint_id,
               COUNT(*) AS business_days
        FROM date_range dr
        WHERE strftime('%w', dr.d) NOT IN ('0', '6')
        GROUP BY dr.complaint_id
    ),
    complaint_with_category AS (
        SELECT b.business_days,
               p.product_category_code
        FROM biz_days b
        JOIN Complaints c ON b.complaint_id = c.complaint_id
        JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
    )
SELECT product_category_code,
       AVG(business_days) AS avg_resolution_business_days
FROM complaint_with_category
GROUP BY product_category_code;

votes.sql:
WITH open_counts AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS open_cnt
    FROM Complaints
    WHERE complaint_status_code = 'Open'
    GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT 
    p.product_category_code,
    SUM(p.product_price * oc.open_cnt) * 0.85 AS total_potential_loss_eur
FROM open_counts oc
JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oc.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_category_code
ORDER BY p.product_category_code;

SELECT SUM(p.product_price * cnt.open_count) * 0.85 AS total_loss_euros
FROM Products p
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS open_count
    FROM Complaints
    WHERE complaint_status_code = 'Open'
    GROUP BY product_id
) cnt ON p.product_id = cnt.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_category_code

WITH open_complaints AS (
  SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS open_cnt
  FROM Complaints
  WHERE complaint_status_code = 'Open'
  GROUP BY product_id
),
top_products AS (
  SELECT product_id, product_price, product_category_code
  FROM Products
  WHERE parent_product_id IS NULL
)
SELECT tp.product_category_code,
       SUM(tp.product_price * COALESCE(oc.open_cnt, 0)) * 0.92 AS loss_eur
FROM top_products tp
LEFT JOIN open_complaints oc ON tp.product_id = oc.product_id
GROUP BY tp.product_category_code;
